stem: Point $B$ is symmetric to $A(-4, 3)$ with respect to the line $3x - y + 5 = 0$. Work out $B$ and tap it on the grid.
solution: Let $B=(s,t)$. The line has gradient 3, so $AB$ has gradient $-\frac13$: $s+3t-5=0$.
The midpoint lies on the line: $3s-t-5=0$.

hints.text: Check which of your two numbers is s (across) and which is t (up).
Check the signs when you solve the two equations.
AB must be perpendicular to the line, and the midpoint of AB must lie on it.
